payload.focus: Tanya sprint retro: async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points highest this quarter, Zephyr integration as key unlock
payload.rationale: This short sprint retro directly names three concepts already in the graph: the async decision widget (core feature / thesis proven), 23-point velocity (echoing the Sprint 4 observation), and the Zephyr integration as key unlock. I expanded Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock and Position_Sprint4ThesisProven as the two positions this document most directly extends or corroborates, then Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus and Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture as the narrative and feature the widget embodies. Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning, Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate, and Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat provide the positioning and problem-frame context the widget exists to solve. Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint is included because it was the prior next-sprint commitment and this retro (dated 2026-09-15, ~6 months later) may bear on whether it was delivered. Position_WebhookArchitecture surfaces the technical decision behind the Zephyr integration. Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform and Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams give category and ICP framing. I deliberately did NOT expand the pricing positions (Position_PricingTwelveDollars, Position_PricingTier25Plus) because this document makes no mention of pricing, packaging, or entitlement.
